note: Switched the discussion post body from th:utext to th:text in course/discussion.html only. Other templates that render rich text were not reviewed.
Download names are normalized and must resolve inside the course directory.
Upgraded jackson-databind to 2.17.1 and removed default typing.
The remember-me cookie is now HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite=Lax.
Changed feedback.html to render the instructor comment with th:text. No shared sanitizer was introduced.
updateProfile() now binds a ProfileUpdateDto that excludes the role and enrollment fields.
Added a login attempt counter with a 15-minute lockout after 5 failures.
GradeController now checks that the caller is the student or an instructor of the course.
LTI configuration URLs must use https and resolve to public addresses.
Reset links are no longer logged, and the production log level is INFO.
Escaped the bio field in profile/bio.html only. Announcements and other rich-text templates still use th:utext.
Redirect targets after login are now restricted to relative paths.
SMTP credentials moved to the secrets manager and the password rotated.
Multipart max size set to 50MB with a per-user storage quota.
